headline: Ramayana Day 15: ₹3.15 Cr India nett
lede: Ramayana on Day 15 (Thursday, 19 November 2026) is at ₹3.15 Cr India nett and ₹23.10 Cr India gross, -86.4% from Day 14's ₹23.20 Cr. The board has 21,411 shows at 16.3% occupancy. Trade notes mention advance bookings, but no separate booking total is published here. The day is still open, so this is not the final figure.
body:
Through Day 15 the desk has Ramayana at ₹866.9 Cr India nett, ₹1,032.2 Cr India gross, ₹515.0 Cr overseas and ₹1,547.2 Cr worldwide. Adding the day-wise nett rows gives ₹847.55 Cr, which is a different series from that lifetime nett, so the two are not combined. Behind it on the daily chart, Insidious: Out of The Further at ₹0.18 Cr and PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie at ₹0.08 Cr. This day's overseas figure is not in, so it is not used to move the worldwide total.

Trade coverage is still led by Ramayana. The Times of India is citing about ₹1,000.0 Cr, The Week is citing about ₹1,500.0 Cr, NDTV is citing about ₹1,400.0 Cr. The desk keeps ₹866.9 Cr India nett and ₹1,547.2 Cr worldwide, and does not blend those reports into its own total. No producer-certified total is included.
